glosses: to hurt, to cause pain to by touching, especially by touching a wound or injury

examples.text: Syknął, uraziwszy się w piekące udo.
examples.translation: He hissed, having hurt himself in his stinging thigh.
examples.english: He hissed, having hurt himself in his stinging thigh.

examples.text: Przerzuciła pistolet do lewej ręki, zignorowała ból, jakim gorąca lufa uraziła jej już ranną dłoń...
examples.translation: She tossed the gun to her left hand; she ignored the pain with which its hot barrel hurt her already injured palm...
examples.english: She tossed the gun to her left hand; she ignored the pain with which its hot barrel hurt her already injured palm...

examples.text: Rin pospiesznie uskoczyła w bok. Zdołała zejść z drogi pociskom, ale źle wylądowała i uraziła sobie kostkę.
examples.translation: Rin hurriedly jumped to the side. She managed to get out of the way of the projectiles, but she landed badly and hurt her ankle.
examples.english: Rin hurriedly jumped to the side. She managed to get out of the way of the projectiles, but she landed badly and hurt her ankle.

glosses: to offend, to hurt (cause emotional pain to), to slight
